scope: Actual returned art recheck: background restoration passed this aspect; source exposure and rim light still fail. Successful request stays successful in service history. No retry count reset, alternate refused payload or new call.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actual exact source, white/cyan/alpha comparison and full raw recheck: the original full dark vignette is now restored, and this improvement is retained. However the return still adds a brighter golden rim along the cheek/neck and more readable brown/yellow facial exposure than the deliberately almost-black original. The original face/eyes and collar remain much closer to black, with only faint original edge illumination. Correct only the exposure and rim intensity to that actual source. Preserve the restored opaque original background, swept dark hair, clean-shaven face, original dark uniform/collar patches/tie, pose and crop; do not remove the vignette or add front lighting. No programmatic colour edit; another targeted built-in art repair is required.
